wire.t: Week 9 Thursday night is final: Trevor Have I Ever leads Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 42.68 to 0.00, Hurts So Good leads Prepetente is the GOAT! 10.50 to 3.90, I Believe in Love leads Young Love Hunters 11.20 to 0.00, Mean Machine leads Chubb So Big I Waddle 9.50 to 0.00, Picken Weiners leads Lemon Squeezy 8.90 to 0.00, and Hanging with Hernandez leads 50 Shades of Rae 5.58 to 0.00.

superdog91 picked up Reggie Virgil (Cardinals WR, 22) and dropped Tanner McKee (Eagles QB, 26) on Wednesday, and RedDevil904 cut Noah Fant (Saints TE, 28). Only two waiver moves hit the log since Tuesday, so the league is mostly waiting on Sunday.

Buccaneer51 put in two waiver claims Tuesday night and won both: Kyle Juszczyk (49ers FB, 35) and Marvin Mims Jr. (Broncos WR, 24). I Believe in Love is 5‑3 and a 92% favorite over Young Love Hunters, so the roster spots are for depth, not panic.

Lamar Jackson has a severe right thumb injury and is headed to injured reserve, with surgery likely and the rest of his season in question. Tyler Huntley is out too. Trevor Have I Ever owns Jackson and starts Trevor Lawrence (20.40 in Week 8) at quarterback.

Picken Weiners hit 180.24, the top score of Week 8, after needing 2.77 from D'Andre Swift and the Seahawks defense on Monday night. Swift scored 27.90 and Seattle added 3.00. Bhayshul Tuten's 29.90 is also the Highest-Scoring RB payout, 0.20 ahead of Tony Pollard's 29.70.
Breece Hall (quad) missed a fourth straight game, but FantasyPros calls Week 9 against the Chiefs a realistic return target. Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 owns him and lost 152.10 to 180.24 without him.

Jeremiyah Love sprained his high ankle in Arizona’s overtime win over Dallas and could miss four to five weeks, with an IR move expected. I Believe in Love owns him, so Buccaneer51 is leaning on a 43.5-point projected edge over Young Love Hunters while the Sunday games sort themselves out.
Carnell Tate (shoulder) was ruled out and his Week 9 status is uncertain. Terry McLaurin is out for the season. Prepetente is the GOAT! has both on the roster and is 2-6 after a fourth straight loss.

stories.title: Trevor Have I Ever leads Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 42.68 to 0.00 after Thursday night
stories.dek: RedDevil904 took the early lead with a Lamar Jackson-less lineup, and Picken Weiners is already 8.90 behind nothing.
body: Thursday night is in the books and the Week 9 scoreboard finally has numbers on it. Trevor Have I Ever has 42.68 from Trevor Lawrence (15.60), Parker Washington (15.10) and the Jaguars defense (12.00), while Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 has not scored a point yet. The model had ChuckJ10 as a 78% favorite. He's 42.68 behind with the rest of the Sunday slate still to come.

Elsewhere: Picken Weiners has 8.90 from Bhayshul Tuten (questionable with an ankle, played anyway) against Lemon Squeezy's 0.00, so Bill_Buttlicker is technically beating the 93% favorite. Hurts So Good leads Prepetente is the GOAT! 10.50 to 3.90 on a Jakobi Meyers night, I Believe in Love has 11.20 from Chris Rodriguez Jr. against Young Love Hunters' 0.00, and Mean Machine has 9.50 from Zay Flowers (5.30) and Brenton Strange (4.20) against Chubb So Big I Waddle.

Nobody should read anything into a Thursday lead. 50 Shades of Rae and Lemon Squeezy haven't played a single starter, and Derrick Henry gave Hanging with Hernandez 5.58 in a game where they're still 51.5 points underdogs. Sunday decides it.

stories.title: Lemon Squeezy is 7‑1 after a 1.76-point escape against Trevor Have I Ever
stories.dek: TotesMagoat was a 44-point favorite and needed Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Rome Odunze on Monday night.
body: Lemon Squeezy trailed 147.00 to 111.26 heading into Monday night and finished 148.76. Smith-Njigba scored 24.80 and Odunze added 12.70. Brock Bowers had 28.20 and Drake Maye had 24.46.
The starters were rough: Jonathan Taylor 6.70, Omarion Hampton 4.70 and the Lions defense 6.00. Jonah Coleman scored 21.40 on the bench and Lemon Squeezy's bench total was 109.00. It still won.
TotesMagoat is 7-1 with 1377.22 points, 93.06 more than anyone else, and a 77-11 all-play record. He owns six firsts across the next three drafts. The league is playing for second.

stories.title: Chubb So Big I Waddle left 38.10 on the bench and lost by 7.08
stories.dek: Aaron Jones Sr. started and scored 6.00. Tyler Allgeier sat and scored 38.10.
body: Chubb So Big I Waddle scored 135.88 and lost to 50 Shades of Rae 142.96. Tyler Allgeier alone would have turned 6.00 into 38.10 at RB2, a 32.10-point swing in a 7.08-point loss. RobMeyers is 3-5 and has lost three straight.

He got 37.50 from Tee Higgins and 23.30 from Braelon Allen, and his bench scored 111.62. His core is one of the oldest in the league, and the only way to keep up is to read the lineup before it locks.
Dynasty note: RobMeyers still owns all nine of his 2027 to 2029 picks in the first three rounds. If this doesn't turn around, Higgins (27) is the trade chip that pays for a real rebuild.

stories.title: Trevor Have I Ever has no 2027 picks and Lamar Jackson is headed to IR
stories.dek: RedDevil904 is 5‑3 after two straight losses and went all-in without much to fall back on.
body: FantasyPros says Lamar Jackson has a severe right thumb injury and is headed to injured reserve, with surgery likely. Trevor Lawrence started in his place in Week 8 and scored 20.40, while Kirk Cousins (38) scored 29.18 on the bench.

RedDevil904 owns no picks in the first three rounds of the 2027 draft. He does own his 2028 and 2029 picks. Trevor Have I Ever lost to Lemon Squeezy by 1.76 this week and to Mean Machine by 82.48 the week before.
5-3 is a playoff team on paper, but Lemon Squeezy and 50 Shades of Rae are both ahead of him, and the quarterback he built around is going on the shelf. This is the dynasty bill coming due.

columns.title: Holden McGroin's Three Waiver Rules For a Thursday With Nothing in It
columns.dek: Two transactions hit the log. I have notes on both.
body: 1. Drop a quarterback when you have no quarterback problem. superdog91 let go of Tanner McKee, a 26-year-old on an Eagles team, which is called roster hygiene.
2. Add a 22-year-old receiver on a Cardinals team because his age is a number. Reggie Virgil is now a superdog91 problem, and the dynasty clock loves him.
3. Cut a tight end and tell nobody. RedDevil904 dropped Noah Fant on Wednesday and issued no statement, which is the strongest possible communication.

Picken Weiners scored 180.24 with a bench that scored 118.22. That's 65.6 percent of the starters' total sitting on the pine. Every percentage point means a different thing, and none of them mean anything.
Young Love Hunters has an all-play record of 0-88. My model has concluded that this is the most consistent team in the league. Please don't check my math.

ChuckJ10 went 13-1 in 2025 and didn't make the final. TotesMagoat went 13-1 in 2023 and lost it. The best record has won it three times in seven years.

th.note: Every trade in Sleeper history, 2019 through 2025, graded by what each side actually got. Value = PPR fantasy points each player scored from the day of the trade through Week 8 of 2026. Picks count the player who was actually drafted with that pick, from his rookie year on. It measures production, not trade value today: a 2025 rookie hasn't had time to catch up to a five-year vet.
th.ledgerNote: Graded trades only. Net = points received minus points sent, added up across every trade. Former managers in italics.

top.t: The Trade That Built an Empire
top.take: In January 2020, superdog91 sent the picks that became Justin Jefferson and Justin Herbert to TotesMagoat for Devin Singletary and a third. Jefferson and Herbert have scored 3,708.3 points since. TotesMagoat has four titles. superdog91 has three, which is impressive given he handed his rival the keys.

Bill_Buttlicker got Patrick Mahomes and the pick that became Chuba Hubbard. G8rDuc got Drew Brees, who retired after the season, and the Michael Carter pick. The scoreboard says 2,853.1 to 529.9. G8rDuc is 22-80 all time, and this is part of why.

ChuckJ10 bought Michael Thomas in November 2020 and paid with Christian Kirk plus his 2021 and 2022 firsts. Thomas gave him 220.1 points. The 2022 first became Chris Olave. ChuckJ10 has never made a final, and trades like this are a big reason why.

superdog91 got Kenny Gainwell and the picks that became George Pickens (#16) and Kyren Williams, a fourth-rounder at #40, all for Devin Singletary. Kyren alone has 970.9 points. RedDevil904 still has never made the playoffs.

RedDevil904 sent five picks to Bill_Buttlicker for Christian McCaffrey. Those picks became Javonte Williams, Elijah Moore, Kenneth Walker III, Malik Willis and Roschon Johnson. CMC gave RedDevil904 1,482.6 points. The picks have given 2,855.7.

TotesMagoat got Amon-Ra St. Brown from Besch42 for Mecole Hardman Jr. and Quintez Cephus. St. Brown has 1,598.9 points since. Four months later, Besch42 lost the 2021 final to TotesMagoat. He'd handed him the WR1 himself.

Self-roast time. Bill_Buttlicker traded the picks that became DeVonta Smith (#11) and Kenny Gainwell to RedDevil904 for Miles Sanders. Sanders: 524.5. Smith and Gainwell: 1,782.6. The man who runs this website did that.

top.t: Pollard for a Pick That Missed
top.take: superdog91 sent Tony Pollard to ChuckJ10 for a 2021 second that became Terrace Marshall. Pollard has 1,255.7 points since. Marshall has 155.8.

th.curNote: Trades made in 2026, before and during the season. Too early to grade. Hindsight comes next year.
